acquisition.method: Adobe-distributed After Effects SDK archive, obtained by the operator and supplied locally. The repository never vendors the SDK.

license.finding: The SDK archive contains no license, EULA, readme or notice text file. The only documents are two PDFs that redirect to the public documentation site.
license.conclusion: No grant to redistribute header content was found. Committed output is therefore restricted to aggregate counts, hashes and provenance.

hashes.note: Per-header hashes are recorded in aggregate.json perHeader[].sha256.
